definition.short_pass: MA is falling and candle is below/touching MA: state 0 or 1
definition.short_9_of_9: all 9 MAs pass the short condition
definition.near_short_9_of_9: minimum price fall within 1% that makes all 9 states 0/1 using current candle high and recalculated MA
definition.all_ma_below: all 9 candle positions are below MA regardless of MA direction: state 0/3/6
definition.near_all_ma_below: A=price is within 1% above the lowest MA; B=price is already below every MA but candle high still touches/crosses an MA
definition.earnings: forecast EPS must be strictly lower than prior full-year EPS
definition.earnings_rank: A=EPS worsening + result miss + progress deterioration; B=EPS worsening + either result miss or progress deterioration; C=EPS worsening only

downside_overextension.weekly: exclude if w13<=-10%, w26<=-15%, w52<=-20% all hold
downside_overextension.monthly: exclude if m12<=-15%, m24<=-30%, m60<=-40% all hold
downside_overextension.monthly_composite: exclude if m12/m24/m60 are each <=-15% and their average <=-25%

definition.shortability: not_checked; borrow/stock-loan availability must be verified separately before trading
